note: Wren Phonics — Fast Track placement (b410, 2026-10-08). Reuses the Wren Phonics placement check rather than a second diagnostic. provenance: Wren original, b410, 2026-10-08.
procedure: Administer the Wren Phonics placement check: GPC recognition, one graded word per half-term, and tricky words, same as a new-starter assessment elsewhere in Wren Phonics.
Record every GPC the pupil reads correctly and securely into a set.
Find the first core-schedule week whose full cumulative GPC requirement the pupil does NOT yet cover — that is where normal-pace teaching would start.
Find the Fast Track stage/week whose source weeks include that core-schedule week (see the weekly plans table), and start there.

If the result lands inside a stage rather than at its very start, begin at that stage's first Fast Track week so nothing in between is silently skipped, and move faster through anything already secure during the first session rather than skipping it on paper.
example: A pupil secure on every Phase 2 and Phase 3 GPC but with gaps from Phase 4 onward places at the start of the Fast Track week whose source weeks first introduce Phase 4 content — Stage 5 of the pathway (Reception Summer 1) in the current schedule.
